_about: Copy for the home page (start.html), rendered by scripts/make-marketing-pages.mjs. The shape (28 Oct 2026): a hero with one action, four stage cards, three points on keeping your work, a plans teaser and one closing action. Every claim is checkable in this repo. No price, no date, no social proof. A figure is a {{fms:...}} stamp (dragon.*, price.from.day) filled by the fms-start-figures plugin in vite.config.js, never typed.

hero.h1: From first draft to final call sheet
hero.sub: Write the screenplay, break it down and plan the shoot in one place. Your work is saved in your own browser first.
hero.note: Shown on the sample feature, {{fms:dragon.scenes}} scenes long, which you can open and look around before you write.
hero.mediaLabel: On the sample feature: a scene moved to another shoot day, and that day's call sheet built from the board

stages.body: A screenplay writer for Tamil, Tanglish and English. The format sets itself as you type, and every scene heading becomes a scene.
stages.bodyElsewhere: A screenplay writer in the standard format. It sets itself as you type, and every scene heading becomes a scene.

stages.body: Place your beats on one of eleven story structures and see where the pacing sags.
Break the script down, build the shot list and lay your scenes onto a stripboard.
Build each day's call sheet from the board, print it or send it on WhatsApp. The budget starts from dated Chennai rates.
stages.bodyElsewhere: Build each day's call sheet from the board, print it or send it on WhatsApp. The budget is line by line and follows the money.

items.title: Saved in your browser
items.text: Every keystroke is written to this device first. Sync to your other devices is yours to switch off.

items.title: Works without a signal
items.text: Install it like an app. It works on set offline for up to 14 days after you last signed in on that device.

items.title: Backed up your way
items.text: Download a backup of every project whenever you like, and restore it from the same menu.

plans.teaser: A year of the studio from about {{fms:price.from.day}} a day. Breakdown, scheduling and call sheets are part of the plans, not add-ons.

closing.h2: Open the studio and write scene one
closing.sub: Sign up with Google to start. Every tool reads the same scenes.

meta.title: {{brand:name}}: from first draft to final call sheet
meta.description: Write the screenplay, break it down and plan the shoot in one place. Built for indie directors, writers and line producers; your work stays in your own browser.

pass._: The line in the plans teaser and the hero and closing buttons. `note` shows only while the launch pass is open (its slots are filled from the server); `off` is what everybody else reads. `open` replaces both for a signed-in visitor.
pass.note: {length} of the whole studio for {price}, once per account, paid through Razorpay. {passTerms} Move to a yearly plan whenever you like.
pass.off: Each plan card states its price and terms before you pay. {planTerms}
pass.open: You are signed in: your plan is on the Purchase page.
